## 1. Purpose

The purpose of this Acceptable Use Policy (POL-COMP-002) is to outline the acceptable use of Acme Corp’s technology resources, specifically regarding the Customer Portal and Support Desk systems. This policy aims to protect both the company and its customers from potential security threats, data breaches, and misuse of resources.

## 2. Scope

This policy applies to all employees, contractors, interns, and any other individuals who have access to Acme Corp technology resources, including but not limited to the Customer Portal and Support Desk systems. It encompasses all activities related to the use of these systems and the handling of sensitive data.

## 3. Policy Statements

### 3.1 General Usage Guidelines

- All users must access the Customer Portal and Support Desk systems in a manner consistent with their role and responsibilities.
- Users must adhere to all security protocols and procedures as defined in related policies.
- Company laptops must use full-disk encryption to protect sensitive information.

### 3.2 Data Handling and Security

- Customer data must never be pasted into external generative AI tools. This includes but is not limited to text, images, and any personally identifiable information (PII).
- Sharing credentials or MFA devices is prohibited. Each user is responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login information.
- All data handled in the Customer Portal and Support Desk systems must comply with the guidelines set forth in POL-COMP-001: Data Retention Policy.

### 3.3 Incident Reporting

- Users are required to monitor their access and usage of the Customer Portal and Support Desk systems for any suspicious activity.
- Suspected violations of this policy must be reported to the Security team within 24 hours to ensure timely investigation and remediation. 
- Any incidents impacting the integrity, availability, or confidentiality of data must be managed according to the procedures outlined in POL-COMP-003: Incident Response Policy.

### 3.4 Access Control

- Users must ensure that access to the Customer Portal and Support Desk systems is limited to authorized personnel only, in accordance with POL-COMP-004: Access Control Policy.
- Users must not attempt to bypass or disable any security mechanisms that are in place to protect these systems.

### 3.5 Compliance and Legal Requirements

- Users are expected to understand and comply with all applicable laws and regulations regarding data protection and privacy.
- Any use of Acme Corp technology resources must be for legitimate business purposes and in alignment with company objectives.

## 4. Roles and Responsibilities

- Users must familiarize themselves with this policy and ensure compliance in their daily activities.
- The on-call engineer is responsible for monitoring system performance and addressing any issues that arise during their shift.
- The Incident Commander is responsible for coordinating the response to any reported incidents, ensuring that all relevant parties are informed and involved as necessary.
- The owning team must ensure that the Customer Portal and Support Desk systems are maintained according to best practices for security and data protection.

## 5. Exceptions

Exceptions to this policy may only be made with prior written approval from the appropriate authority within the organization. Any approved exceptions will be documented, and the rationale for the exception will be communicated to all relevant stakeholders.

## 6. Enforcement

Failure to comply with this Acceptable Use Policy may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment or contract. Violations may also lead to legal action if warranted. The enforcement of this policy will be monitored, and any incidents of non-compliance will be investigated thoroughly.
